  PROBLEM: The changelog incorrectly says `ci.yml` does not run on pull requests into the routed branch.

  PROBLEM: The staging fail-closed guard defaults an unset routing variable to `false`, unlike the resolver's new `true` default.
  WHY: If the variable is unset and resolver staging fails, the guard can allow the default-branch fallback instead of failing closed; reviewers rated this NIT and MAJOR, and the highest severity is used.

  WHY: With the new default-on behavior, unset should follow the routing-on path and fail closed when staging fails; reviewers rated this NIT and MAJOR, and the highest severity is used.
